about: I'm a Senior Software Engineer (SDE-2) who approaches AI work as a solution architect, not just an implementer: turning a business problem into an AI architecture, deciding where an LLM helps and where plain code is safer, and making the parts fit together.

That covers agentic workflows with tool calling, guardrails, evaluation and human review; retrieval (RAG) grounded in a company's own data; cutting the cost and latency of LLM workloads; and the production basics many AI projects skip: observability, testing, scaling and security.

Underneath is 9+ years of backend and distributed systems work across SaaS, B2B e-commerce, healthcare, logistics and fantasy sports, for clients in India, the UK, the Middle East, Africa and Indonesia.

bio: I'm a senior software engineer with 9+ years of building backend-heavy, high-scale systems, and these days I design and build AI systems that work in production, not just in demos. At [Spark Eighteen](experience/#spark-eighteen) I build agentic AI and LLM features for enterprise clients, including an AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot for a [VC deal-sourcing CRM](projects/#vc-crm) and the backend of a multi-tenant [pharma compliance platform](projects/#pharma-saas).

Before that I was a Technical Lead at Ziqonfox Technologies, leading a team of 15+ engineers on a [B2B e-commerce engine](projects/#shopdotapp) that went on to raise venture funding, and a [fantasy sports platform](projects/#leagueswype) that served 10,000+ concurrent users with zero downtime.

On the side, I build [Claude Code Router](projects/#claude-code-router), an open-source tool that sends each coding task to the cheapest Claude model that can handle it. It has 2,000+ downloads on PyPI, an npm package, and an estimated 78% cost saving in my own use.

I write about system design, databases and AI engineering on [my blog](https://devlore.hashnode.dev/) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/satya-prakash-be/). My work spans e-commerce, healthcare, logistics, recruitment and workflow automation, for clients in India, the UK, the Middle East, Africa and Indonesia.
